D3_channel_interpretation: The six unitary conjugation channels on W5 have positive Gram24I6+J6. A classical D3 group-walk probability therefore gives a faithful random-unitary channel without choosing a regular submodule. Its channel coefficients, its spectrum on End(W5), and its normalized heat trace are different observables; only the physical readout law can select one.

color_law.Gaussian_comparison: Only for a separately postulated centered Gaussian Hermitian matrix G with Cov(Tr(BG),Tr(CG))=2*Tr(B*C)/d for Hermitian B,C does X=w*Tr(EG) have log-MGF w^2*Tr(E^2)/d. Isotropy alone does not fix that covariance normalization. Twirling before this response changes r/d to r/(3d); averaging covariant responses after nonlinear evaluation is a distinct protocol.

proposal_law.native: A uniform proposal chooses one of 30 undirected seams. Strict-descent admission executes its unique downhill unit transfer only at load difference at least two; otherwise the step is zero.
proposal_law.proof: The missing raw second moment is the sum of positive outer products of rejected seam increments divided by30; covariance subtracts the mean outer product. Covariance positivity is its weighted centered-outer-product formula.
proposal_law.symmetrized: The full MGF additionally averages both directions with equal weight. This is a symmetrized proposal alphabet, not an asserted physical orientation or accepted-history law.
